deliverables: Performance optimization with 2x to 10x improvements in snapshot signing and memory profile, plus reduced L1 fees through on-chain contract optimization.
Operational excellence including operator runbooks, simpler node configuration, observability and logging, and an improved TUI.
Ecosystem support including production-user requested features, Hydra Alliance facilitation, hackathons, and developer relations.
Maintenance and developer experience work including CI, tooling, and technical debt reduction.
request.recipient: Input Output Global / IO: Hydra proposal authors; exact withdrawal reward account recipient not stated in document
request.what: Fund the IO: Hydra proposal to deliver a feature-complete and hardened Hydra v2 across performance optimization, operational excellence, ecosystem support, and developer experience workstreams.

claims.claim: Hydra is described as the only production-grade or production-ready Layer 2 scaling solution on Cardano.
The proposal states that Hydra is already running or has powered workloads for Delta DeFi, Masumi, Intersect voting infrastructure, VTech Labs, Blockfrost, Midgard, Hydra Doom, and Glacier Drop.
The proposal says Hydra provides sub-second finality, near-zero or zero internal fees, high throughput, and L1-grade settlement by settling final state back to Cardano L1.

The proposer claims current Cardano L1 performance has over two hours finality, about $0.17 per payment transaction, and roughly 7 to 10 TPS, causing high-performance builders to exclude Cardano early.
The proposal claims a single Hydra Head processes up to 1,000+ TPS in payment benchmarks and that aggregate throughput scales close to linearly with the number of independent Heads.
The proposal claims the funded work will improve snapshot signing and memory profile by 2x to 10x and reduce L1 fees through on-chain contract optimization.

The proposer claims Hydra can increase Cardano ecosystem activity, TVL, developer activity, L1 settlement usage, and treasury sustainability through head lifecycle transactions and optionally routed head fees.
The proposal states the ask is milestone-gated, with independent third-party assurance and Intersect providing administrative treasury governance.
The proposal claims provisional users under evaluation include Bodega Market, Atlas Defi, Wingriders, Houselink, European Public Network, and others.
The document includes author witnesses for Input Output Global and Intersect using CIP-0008 or ed25519 signatures.

summary: The document requests ₳5,100,781 for Hydra v2 hardening and adoption work, but most material technical, adoption, economic-impact, budget, and milestone claims are asserted in the proposal text without the supplied excerpt providing detailed budget analysis, feasibility analysis, alternatives analysis, failure-mode analysis, or community impact analysis.
